# sshgate

> Open a ufw firewall port for your current IP after a secret HTTPS link and a TOTP code: personal, on-demand SSH access from changing IPs, in pure Python stdlib.

sshgate is a small self-hosted alternative to port knocking and single-packet authorization for one administrator of a Linux server. nginx serves an unguessable secret path and proxies it to a localhost Python app; a valid TOTP code makes a tightly scoped sudo helper add `ufw allow from <ip> to any port 22`. A systemd timer removes the rule once it is at least 24 hours old and no SSH session from that IP is active. The UI ships in English, Russian and Spanish.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/README.md): how it works, security model, install, configuration, limitations
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, conventions and gotchas for coding agents
- [app.py](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/app.py): web app, TOTP check, rate limiting, translations
- [install.sh](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/install.sh): installer that creates the user, secrets, sudoers entry and systemd units
- [sbin/sshgate-open](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/sbin/sshgate-open): privileged helper that opens the port for one IPv4 address
- [sbin/sshgate-reap](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/sbin/sshgate-reap): reaper that closes old, idle openings

## Optional

- [nginx/sshgate.example.conf](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/nginx/sshgate.example.conf): reverse-proxy location block
- [config.example.json](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate/blob/main/config.example.json): configuration template
